findings.title: Add verified printed page numbers to 字源 page metadata
findings.details: The inspected 字源 scans for PDF pages 814 and 817 visibly show printed pages 801 and 804, respectively, and the dossier records those page numbers. Current source-page metadata still has printed_page null for both pages, so citations rely on PDF numbering alone.
findings.verification: Update the source page metadata with printed pages 801 and 804 and provenance tied to the inspected scans; verify the source registry and resulting citations expose both PDF and printed page numbers.
